_doc: Reference photos of the fish units (tools/fish_refs.py, judging/FISH.md "Reference photos"): fish.json species id -> photo objects (fish-photos.json's shape, plus rep, from and for: the units each represents: species ids, g:<genus>, fam:<family>). tools/fish_judge.py adds a photo to the game photos of the entry that holds its species once tools/fish_judge.json judges it.
away: the taxon-page photos of a species that pass every rule but the Indo-West Pacific box (Pierre's Q230, open): listed with their rough region (reg), never taken.
